annotations.title: What your Atlas card shows and what it does not

description: For a tool the account has claimed: what the card prints and what it could not read - price, hiring, releases, company - with the page each was read from and what to do about each empty line. Plus the claim's status and premium. Needs a signed-in inite.ai account: a guest call answers 401 and starts the OAuth flow.
